purpose: Allowlist of Traditional story IDs whose meta_<id>.json exists on disk but is intentionally NOT shipped via assets/stories/manifest.json. These stories are preserved as legacy assets (per the never-delete-audio rule) but are not part of the active corpus surfaced to users.
policy: Integrity tests treat any meta_<id>.json directory as either (a) referenced by the live manifest, or (b) listed below. Anything else is an unresolved orphan and the test fails. To intentionally retire a shipped story, remove it from manifest.json and add its ID here.

notes.origin: Pre-Opus-4.6-migration 800-series. The current shipping manifest covers IDs 825-1268; these 28 were dropped during the Opus 4.6 cutover (see memory: project_opus46_migration). Their anchors are now covered by newer 825+ stories with the same scripture references.
notes.doNotDelete: Per the never-delete-audio rule these directories must remain intact. This file only marks them as 'known orphan, intentional', not 'safe to remove'.
